Definition: from a derivative of a compound of G3650 and a derivative of G2545; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.
BiblicalUsage: holokaútōma is the word for (whole) burnt offering. I meet it 3 times across the Bible, and Mark is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What holokaútōma tells me is that God wants the whole of us, not a part. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
